The API lives in `packages/api/src/`. Request-body validation happens at these sites:

**Call sites (per-route):**
- `packages/api/src/server.js:21` — `POST /users`: `validateBody({ name: "string", email: "string" }, body)`; rejects with 400 at line 22
- `packages/api/src/server.js:28` — `PATCH /users/:email`: `validateBody({ name: "string" }, body)`; rejects with 400 at line 29
- `packages/api/src/server.js:37` — `POST /orders`: inline check `typeof body.sku !== "string" || !(body.quantity > 0)`; rejects with 400 on the same line

**The validator itself:**
- `packages/api/src/validate.js:2` — rejects non-object bodies (`"body must be an object"`)
- `packages/api/src/validate.js:5` — per-key type check against the schema

Note: `packages/api/src/server.js:10` (`JSON.parse` in `readJson`) parses the body but isn't validation — malformed JSON throws, and as the comment at line 45 points out, nothing catches it, so it surfaces as an unhandled rejection rather than a 400.
